messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Review and Decision-Making" as it appears in the following examples.
['If you are interested in this proposal, kindly get back to me by sending me your letter of acceptance along with your direct telephone and fax numbers.', 'Please kindly communicate your acceptance of this proposal so that we can discuss the modalities of seeing this transaction through.', 'I want you to assist me to claim this money as I cannot claim it directly because I am still a Civil servant, and the code of conduct bureau forbid me to acquire such amount of money.', 'Please review this matter and advise us of your position.', 'Once you indicate your interest, I will initiate the processing of the transfer and in about 14 working days the money total £12.5m will be in your nominated bank account for us to share.', 'I wish you go through this offer to consider being my partner.', 'Furthermore, we are reviewing your account and unfortunately your account limitation cannot be lifted at this time.', 'If This Beneficial Request Is Ok And Acceptable To You, Do Contact Me The Above Contact Information Or My Attached E-Mail Address.', 'If this purchase was made by the mistake, and you want to cancel the subscription, click the link under the subscription options in this message, and then change the password on your Apple account, supposedly it was stolen.', 'For your protection, you must verify this activity before you can continue using your account.', 'PLEASE, DO NOT HESITATE TO INDICATE YOUR VIEW OF THIS REQUEST BY CONTACTING ME IMMEDIATELY YOU RECEIVE THIS MAIL, SO THAT THE NECESSARY ARRANGEMENTS CAN BE MADE FOR THE MONEY TO LEAVE IMMEDIATELY.', 'I now seek your consent to present you as the next of kin Of the deceased so that the Proceeds of this account valued at 9.8 million dollars can be paid to you.', 'By visiting the link below please open the form of the member details approval:']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
